name: Titanium.UI.iOS.SystemButton
summary: A set of constants for creating standard iOS system buttons.
description:
Most of these constants are used with the
[Button.systemButton](api:Titanium.UI.Button#systemButton) property to define a standard
iOS system buttons for use in navigation bars and toolbars.

See [Titanium.UI.Button](api:Titanium.UI.Button) for more information on the `systemButton` property, including details
on where system buttons can be used. In an Alloy application you can omit the `Ti.UI.iOS.SystemButton`
namespace when assigning a value to the `<Button>` element's `systemButton` attribute,
for example:

``` xml
<Button systemButton="CAMERA"/>
<!-- Instead of -->
<Button systemButton="Titanium.UI.iOS.SystemButton.CAMERA"/>
```

A few of these constants are used with [Button.style](api:Titanium.UI.Button#style) to
create standard iOS buttons that can be used in other places, including table view rows.
Note: Starting at Titanium SDK 5.0, all icons have are automatically sized in the native behavior and are not distorted any more. These standard button types are:

* [CONTACT_ADD](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.SystemButton#CONTACT_ADD)
* [DISCLOSURE](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.SystemButton#DISCLOSURE)
* [INFO_DARK](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.SystemButton#INFO_DARK)
* [INFO_LIGHT](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.SystemButton#INFO_LIGHT)

See Apple's 
[iOS Human Interface Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/ios/human-interface-guidelines/overview/themes/) in the iOS Developer Library for details on the proper usage of iOS standard buttons and icons.

![System Icons](./system_icons.png)

properties.name: ACTION
properties.summary: Use with [Button.systemButton](api:Titanium.UI.Button#systemButton) to specify an **Action** button.
properties.description: The resulting button can only be used in navigation bars and toolbars.

properties.name: ACTIVITY
properties.summary:
Use with [Button.systemButton](api:Titanium.UI.Button#systemButton) to create an activity indicator that
can be used in navigation bars and toolbars.
properties.description: When visible, the activity indicator is already started.

properties.summary:
Use with [Button.systemButton](api:Titanium.UI.Button#systemButton) to create a fixed-width blank space

properties.description: Only the `width` property is used when this value is set.

properties.name: FLEXIBLE_SPACE
properties.summary:
Use with [Button.systemButton](api:Titanium.UI.Button#systemButton) to create a flexible blank space 
for spacing items in toolbars.
properties.description:
The space is distributed equally between the other 
items. Other item properties are ignored when this value is set.
